features.statement: Page title is a short brand name only, without subtitle or trailing separators.
The main headline is a real h1 element holding the featured story title.
Heading structure balances h2 section titles with h3 subheadings rather than relying mostly on h2s.
Uses semantic landmarks: a single header, nav, several sections and a footer, instead of repeated article wrappers.
Includes ARIA attributes for accessibility.
Page is self-contained: one inline style block, no external scripts or stylesheets.
Serif body text is paired with a Helvetica-style sans for headings and UI text.
Section titles are bold sans-serif with a thick dark underline rule beneath each.
Body text is slightly larger with generous line height, about 17px over 26px.
Headings are large and bold, with a 40px h1 and bold 24px h2s.
Dates and footer headings are set in uppercase with letter spacing.
Off-white cream page background with a dark green hero band and header/footer bands.
Palette is deep green, mustard yellow and cream, with teal-green links and mustard buttons.
Body text is a green-tinted near-black rather than neutral grey.
Compact single-row header combines logo, navigation, pill search and a call-to-action button.
Hero is split into a text column on one side and a cropped image on the other.
Search field is a white rounded pill with a magnifier icon.
Layout relies on CSS grid and flexbox, with a narrower centered content width.
Content blocks mix a full-width media row with two-column rows below.
Video block has a large thumbnail with a centered play button and white related-video cards with an accent left border.
Link arrows are right arrows (→) in 'view all' style links.
Partner logos are large, evenly sized and shown on a full-width white band.
Images have descriptive alt text.
Social icons are small images placed inside white circular badges.
Uses a mix of pill and medium rounded corners on components.
Flat styling with no box shadows and minimal gradients.
Defines CSS transitions for interactive hover states.
Cards are defined by hairline borders, rounded corners and dashed outlines rather than solid fills.
Empty states carry friendly microcopy with a pill button call to action.
Page runs taller with more generous spacing.
